content.text: {"abstained": false, "abstention_reason": "", "answer": "The National Bamboo Mission (NBM) is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme launched in 2018-19 by the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare [E01]. It was restructured following a 2017 amendment to the Indian Forest Act that excluded bamboo from the definition of tree, allowing bamboo grown in non-forest areas to be outside forest regulations [E01]. The scheme focuses on developing the complete value chain of the bamboo sector, from planting material and plantation to processing, marketing, and brand building in a cluster approach [E01]. Key objectives include increasing bamboo plantation area on non-forest lands to supplement farm income and support climate resilience, improving post-harvest management, promoting product development, rejuvenating the bamboo industry, promoting skill development, and reducing dependency on bamboo imports [E01]. The scheme is applicable to all farmers in India and provides assistance to farmers, government agencies, artisans, entrepreneurs, and other persons involved in the bamboo industry for establishing nurseries, cultivation, processing, manufacturing, and capacity building [E02].", "cited_evidence_ids": ["E01", "E02"], "claim_to_evidence": [{"claim": "NBM is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme launched in 2018-19", "evidence_ids": ["E01"]}, {"claim": "It was restructured following a 2017 amendment to the Indian Forest Act that excluded bamboo from the definition of tree", "evidence_ids": ["E01"]}, {"claim": "The scheme focuses on developing the complete value chain of the bamboo sector", "evidence_ids": ["E01"]}, {"claim": "Key objectives include increasing bamboo plantation area, improving post-harvest management, promoting product development, and reducing import dependency", "evidence_ids": ["E01"]}, {"claim": "The scheme is applicable to all farmers in India and provides assistance to various stakeholders", "evidence_ids": ["E02"]}]}
